source: You strike the ground and a burst of divine energy ripples outward. Each creature you choose within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure it takes 5d6 thunder damage plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic damage, your choice, and is knocked prone. On a success it takes half as much damage and is not knocked prone.
Enervation

A shadowy tendril reaches for a creature within range. It must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 necrotic damage on a success and ending the spell. On a failure the tendril latches on and deals 4d8 necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, healing you for half that amount.
Far Step
Pick an unoccupied space you can see up to 60 feet away and appear in it. On any later turn of yours a bonus action repeats the jump, until the spell ends.
Holy Weapon

You imbue a weapon you touch with holy power. For the duration it emits bright light and deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage on a hit. You can end the spell early as a bonus action to make the weapon burst: each creature within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d8 radiant damage and being blinded for a minute on a failure, or half damage and no blindness on a success.
Immolation

Flames wreathe one creature you can see within range. It must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure and half as much on a success. On a failure it burns for the duration, shedding bright light and taking 4d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
Infernal Calling
You summon a devil of challenge rating 6 or lower from the Nine Hells. It is not under your control and acts on its own, testing the limits of any bargain you strike with it while it remains.
Maelstrom

A mass of swirling water appears in a 30-foot radius centred on a point you can see. It is difficult terrain, and a creature that enters it or starts its turn there must make a Strength saving throw or take 6d6 bludgeoning damage and be pulled 10 feet toward the centre.
Negative Energy Flood

You send ribbons of negative energy at a creature within range. Unless it is undead it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d12 necrotic damage on a failure and half as much on a success; a humanoid killed by it rises as a zombie under your command. An undead target instead gains half that many temporary hit points.
Skill Empowerment
Touch a willing creature and name a skill it is already proficient in. Until the spell ends its proficiency bonus counts double on ability checks made with that skill.
Steel Wind Strike

You flicker between up to five creatures you can see within range, striking each one. Make a melee spell attack against each target; on a hit it takes 6d10 force damage. You then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of one of the targets.
Summon Celestial

You call a celestial spirit to an unoccupied space you can see. You choose an Avenger form that attacks at range or a Defender form that shields allies; it acts on your turn using your spellcasting numbers and can heal with its touch.
Summon Draconic Spirit

You call a draconic spirit to an unoccupied space you can see. You choose chromatic, metallic or gem, and it acts on your turn with your spellcasting numbers, flying, biting, and exhaling a breath weapon of its kind.
Swift Quiver
A quiver you touch refills itself faster than you can empty it. Each turn until the spell ends, a bonus action lets you attack twice with a weapon drawing ammunition from that quiver.
Synaptic Static

You choose a point within range and psychic energy bursts in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area that can think must make an Intelligence saving throw, taking 8d6 psychic damage on a failure and half as much on a success. A creature that failed also has muddled thoughts for a minute, subtracting 1d6 from its attack rolls, ability checks and Constitution saves for concentration.
Temporal Shunt

You shunt the creature a moment out of time. On a failed Wisdom saving throw its attack or spell is wasted and it vanishes until the end of your next turn, returning to its space with no memory of the gap.
Transmute Rock

You choose a 40-foot cube of stone or mud within range. Stone becomes thick mud, making the area difficult terrain and restraining creatures that fail a Dexterity saving throw; mud becomes stone, trapping creatures that fail a save until they are freed.
Wall of Light

A wall of brilliant light 60 feet long, 10 feet high and 5 feet thick springs up. A creature in its area when it appears takes 4d8 radiant damage and is blinded for a minute, halved and unblinded on a successful Constitution saving throw. As an action you can collapse the wall into a 60-foot beam for the same damage.
Wrath of Nature

You rouse the natural world in a 60-foot cube. Trees lash at creatures you choose for 4d6 slashing damage, grasses and undergrowth restrain them, roots trip them, and loose rocks fly at them for 3d6 bludgeoning damage, each with its own saving throw.
Arcane Gate

You create two linked 10-foot-diameter rings of magic, one on a surface you can see within range and one on a surface you can see within 10 feet of yourself. Any creature or object entering one portal leaves through the other. As a bonus action on a later turn you can turn either portal to face a new direction.
Bones of the Earth
